## What it does

litterbayes fits decomposition models to litter-bag mass-loss data in a Bayesian framework. Uncertainty carries through to decay-rate estimates, so they can be compared across studies, sites, and litter types.

## Highlights

- Nonlinear two-pool decay models fit with brms
- Designed for researchers working with litter-bag decomposition data
